646:t_1:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, let us begin... a banquet of revenge in this closed universe.」

646:t_1:7.en:
???
(So you... will not forgive us after all...)

646:t_2:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「You said it before, Uncle... That the $$御使い$$s twisted $$ガイゾック$$'s mission, too.」

646:t_2:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The $$御使い$$s refuse to accept evolution. When humanity seeks to cross the line they have imposed, they seek to destroy it.」

646:t_2:8.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$ガイゾック$$ likely concluded that humanity's existence invites the $$御使い$$s' intervention, and judged humanity itself to be evil as the cause.」

646:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「And so they destroy civilization... to halt evolution by returning humanity to a primitive way of life...」

646:t_2:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ロラン$$... Don't tell me...!」

646:t_2:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes... That may also have been the purpose of burying civilization with the $$月光蝶$$...」

646:t_2:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Even so, I'm not going to feel sorry for $$ガイゾック$$. They're our enemies.」

646:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is fine... You kept telling $$ガイゾック$$ that you believed in humanity.」

646:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Once you have exhausted your words, you need neither sympathy nor hesitation toward evil... That, too, is one truth.」

646:t_2:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I agree with $$ゼウス$$, $$勝平$$.」

646:t_2:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Unfortunately, this world has opponents who will not accept our logic, ethics, or common sense.」

646:t_2:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Does that mean it's OK to punch people like that?」

646:t_2:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「No. But... in many cases, such people ultimately turn to force to reject us.」

646:t_2:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Once it reaches that point, we have no choice but to play by their rules. That is when hesitation becomes unnecessary.」

646:t_2:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「So when danger comes our way, we have to fend it off.」

646:t_2:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And to add to that, we're fighting to stop that danger from spreading.」

646:t_2:23.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Do not yield to evil. That is the duty of a guardian god.」

646:t_2:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So you're officially one of $c starting today! We're counting on you!」

646:t_2:26.en:
$$柿小路$$
「P-President! $$勝平$$! You're speaking to a god!」

646:t_2:27.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Don't concern yourselves. The title of god is an expression of pride in our power, not a claim to be an object of worship.」

646:t_2:28.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The gods of $$オリュンポス$$, myself included, Emperor $$ズール$$, and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ have misunderstood that and merely grown arrogant in their supposed superiority.」

646:t_2:30.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The proof is that you have entered a new era. One day, Earthlings, too, will ascend into higher-dimensional life-forms.」

646:t_2:31.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're saying we'll become like you and the $$御使い$$s?」

646:t_2:32.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「However, several conditions must be met, and reaching that point within an individual's lifespan would be impossible.」

646:t_2:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(One means of doing so must be integration into the collective unconscious...)

646:t_2:34.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(Killing God... In other words, all of humanity, ourselves included, becoming one with God...)

646:t_2:35.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(So that was $$シャルル$$'s chosen way to overcome the fundamental calamity... the future of despair...)

646:t_2:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... That's a letdown. If I became like you, Uncle $$ゼウス$$, I'd send the $$御使い$$s and $$バアル$$ flying!」

646:t_2:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No griping, no griping. Let's move forward one step at a time, in our own way.」

646:t_2:38.en:
$$勝平$$
「...You're right. Even if I suddenly became a god, I wouldn't know what to do.」

646:t_2:39.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(But you are certainly walking that path...)

646:t_2:40.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(One day, the Steel Hero will become one with your souls and lend you its power...)

646:t_2:43.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ゼウス$$ said higher-dimensional life-forms must not interfere unnecessarily with present humanity...」

646:t_2:44.en:
$$万丈$$
「That was probably why the $$御使い$$s hid their existence.」

646:t_2:45.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Does that mean they were willing to follow the rules, too?」

646:t_2:46.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「If so, maybe there's still some hope for them.」

646:t_2:47.en:
$$万丈$$
「No... That was probably due to their pride.」

646:t_2:49.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「They call themselves servants of the Supreme God. At the same time, they look down on the other gods as inferior beings.」

646:t_2:50.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「At first glance, they seem to belittle themselves, but they place everyone else even lower. In other words, they are still calling themselves the best.」

646:t_2:51.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ギャリソン$$ is right. They take pride in believing that their existence is the greatest in this universe.」

646:t_2:52.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is why they made a show of following the rules.」

646:t_2:53.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「But people like that break the rules without a second thought, then justify it with some forced argument.」

646:t_2:54.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Yes. As if their very existence were the rules.」

646:t_2:55.en:
$$万丈$$
「I agree with that. That is precisely why something about their actions remains unclear.」

646:t_2:57.en:
$$万丈$$
「The existence of the $$時の牢獄$$.」

646:t_2:58.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「The thing that covered $$蒼の地球$$?」

646:t_2:59.en:
$$万丈$$
「Judging from $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$'s actions, its creator must have been someone above $$サイデリアル$$... the $$御使い$$s, in other words.」

646:t_2:60.en:
$$万丈$$
「And apparently $$ガドライト#pilot$$ said it was created to protect the people of Earth.」

646:t_2:61.en:
$$万丈$$
「But $$サイデリアル$$, having conquered $$翠の地球$$, began invading $$蒼の地球$$ when the $$時の牢獄$$ was broken.」

646:t_2:62.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「Hmm... That is indeed contradictory. It was meant for the $$御使い$$s to protect Earthlings, yet it prevented their invasion of Earth...」

646:t_2:63.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Do they want to protect Earthlings or rule them? Which is it!?」

646:t_2:64.en:
$$万丈$$
「Unfortunately, I don't know... Speculating here probably won't give us an answer.」

646:t_2:65.en:
$$万丈$$
「But the key to resolving that contradiction seems to lie in 'sorrow.'」

646:t_2:66.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Do you mean $$セツコ$$?」

646:t_2:68.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The four human emotions: joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure... If there are $$御使い$$s governing joy, anger, and pleasure, there must be one for sorrow, too.」

646:t_2:69.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$御使い$$ who has yet to appear... That must be the one who governs sorrow.」

646:t_2:70.en:
$$万丈$$
「And I suspect that being holds the key to the contradictions among the $$御使い$$s.」

646:t_2:71.en:
$$万丈$$
(The answer... must lie ahead of us...)

646:t_2:72.en:
$$万丈$$
(Though I can't say whether it will bring us hope...)

646:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$勝平$$. I had the pleasure of witnessing your heroic feat of shooting down $$バンドック$$.」

646:t_10:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Usually, when you compliment someone, it's got something to do with $$Ｚチップ$$s...」

646:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's absolutely right! My, you know me so well!」

646:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Overcoming your past and shooting down $$バンドック$$ generated 100 Z of $$Ｚチップ$$s, $$勝平$$. I'll add them to the team's stock.」
